Pharisæi aliquanti-ꝓ templo acerrime restiterunt: do-nec obstinatis ad mortem animis, ultro se subjectis ignibus intulerunt. Fertur Titus adhibito consilioa ducum. prius deliberasse, an templum tanti operis everteret. page.notes: Stain across the left half of lines 16 to 19 makes the words there partly unreadable; the lost parts are marked. Opening word is a fragment (sianus), the page starts mid-word. Several marginal notes are hard to split exactly: "Orosi-" and "um l.7.c.4" and the "6." note are read from their position beside lines 14 and 15, and the note "Hierofo-lyma va-fata." joins two lines. Line 4 opening word "terea" and line 12 "humanditi" are doubtful. "venunda-ta" is read as a word broken at the line end.
